request.prompt:
Use the attached exact project reference as the ONE dedicated KURTZ boss design. Broad blackened engraved full plate armor, huge spiked steel shoulder pauldrons, decorated closed horn-point helmet with dark visor slit, red neck cloth and skull clasp, LONG TORN SCARLET CAPE, wide long steel GREATSWORD in anatomical RIGHT hand, empty LEFT hand, no shield. Massive plated boots and gauntlets. Keep these same costume proportions and materials on every single sprite. Dark fantasy painted high-quality isometric game sprites, crisp full bodies, fixed camera looking down 25 degrees. NO TEXT, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO shadows, NO visual effects. TRUE transparent background. No clipped blade/cape/helmet/boots. Strict equal-cell grid with at least 12px transparent inset around each complete character in every cell. Never cross cells. All source pixels belong to isolated independent full-body sprites. Canvas portrait 1024x1536.
Exactly 32 separate full-body sprites in a strict 4 COLUMNS x8 ROWS grid. columns EAST (pure right side, points RIGHT), SOUTHEAST (front-right quarter points LOWER RIGHT), SOUTH (front chest faces viewer), SOUTHWEST (front-left quarter points LOWER LEFT). Fixed facing per column. Eight rows: row1 IDLE guarded planted stance; row2 IDLE subtle breath with cape fold movement; row3 ATTACK wind-up, greatsword compact upright behind shoulder and knees loading; row4 ATTACK start-downswing, weight forward and blade following travel direction; row5 ATTACK contact, mighty greatsword fully extended forward toward that column's facing target, complete blade inside cell, knees wide and shoulders rotated; row6 ATTACK followthrough and heavy settling recovery; row7 HIT chest recoils and sword drawn in; row8 HIT maximum recoil/cape lag then recovery. No WALK. Keep body about 145px high per cell to allow the complete extended sword and helmet. Every sword stays wholly inside its own 256px-wide cell. Full character and unique readable action per cell. Keep feet on source plane, natural grounded weight.
